title: Scalar forgetting for raw derived Hom before restricted cohomology
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $k:W\to S$ a scheme morphism, $G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $W$, $q\in\mathbb N$, and $U\to S$ etale. Write $G_{ab}$ for its underlying abelian sheaf and $F_A=A^{-1}G_{ab}$ for $A$ in $\mathrm{Over}(W)$. There are additive isomorphisms from the module raw group $\operatorname{Hom}((A\to S)^*\Lambda[U][0],A^*G[q])$ to the abelian raw group $\operatorname{Hom}((A\to S)^*\mathbb Z[U][0],F_A[q])$. They intertwine every explicit five-factor module raw pullback with the five-factor abelian raw pullback whose coefficient arrow is the inverse inverse-image-composition comparison $f^{-1}F_B\to F_A$. No affineness, limit or qcqs hypotheses are required. The raw groups and maps are those of [def-sbc-higher-image-raw-diagram] and [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison].

source.place: Tag 03FD, lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree; Tag 03Q8 and its cited restriction lemmas

proof.text: Construct the canonical additive raw scalar comparison by forgetting the derived class, precomposing with the represented generator map and using the canonical Kan-extension/sheafification coefficient isomorphism. Its invertibility gives asIso at each A. The independent naturality theorem for this same constructed map is then exactly the required pointwise pullback equation. No component isomorphisms are chosen from an unconstrained existence statement.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8, explicit scalar comparison; isomorphism and naturality separated, with canonical inverse-image comparisons from 03D3/03D7

theorem exists_rawModule_abelianHom_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale) :
    ∃ e : ∀ A : Over W,
      (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op A) ≅
        (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf (A.hom ≫ k) q
          (restrictedOverCoefficient
            ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
            A)).obj (op U),
      ∀ (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
        (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)),
        (e A).hom ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z) =
          abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
            (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) q
            (restrictedOverCoefficient
              ((sheafCompose _
                (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) B)
            (restrictedOverCoefficient
              ((sheafCompose _
                (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) A)
            ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left B.hom A.hom
              (Over.w f).symm).inv.app
                ((sheafCompose _
                  (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G))
            U ((e B).hom z)
